Game Overview

In Floppa Scary Horror, the core idea is straightforward: venture into the chilling, dark forest of Floppa Scary Horror, where humor meets terror. Collect eight whimsical cat photos while evading the infamous Big Floppa. Navigate unpredictable encounters and face jump scares in haunting, immersive 3D landscapes. Can you outsmart this meme-fueled nightmare?
